vocabulary.meaning_en: to improve something or make it better
vocabulary.example: A little lemon will enhance the taste of the soup.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to give time, energy or money to help achieve a goal
vocabulary.example: Everyone in the team contributed to the project.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to change or adjust because of new conditions
vocabulary.note_ar: adapt to + شيء. لا تخلطها مع adopt (يتبنّى)
vocabulary.note_en: adapt to something. Don't confuse with adopt.
vocabulary.example: I can adapt to new situations easily.

vocabulary.meaning_en: working well without wasting time, effort or money
vocabulary.example: The new system is more efficient.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to communicate or make an idea or feeling known
vocabulary.example: I'd like to convey my thanks for your hard work.

vocabulary.note_ar: رسمية بعض الشيء، تأتي في بداية الجملة غالبًا
vocabulary.note_en: A little formal; often starts a sentence.
vocabulary.example: The flat is cheap. Furthermore, it's close to my work.

vocabulary.meaning_en: as a result; because of that
vocabulary.example: He missed the bus. Consequently, he was late for work.

vocabulary.meaning_en: looking at it the opposite way; on the other hand
vocabulary.example: John's idea is good. Conversely, if we wait a week, we might get a better result.

vocabulary.meaning_en: long, heavy or difficult to use
vocabulary.example: That sentence is cumbersome; use one word instead.

vocabulary.meaning_en: all the things (words, skills) a person can use
vocabulary.example: Add these words to your repertoire.

vocabulary.meaning_en: without waiting any longer; let's start
vocabulary.example: And now, without further ado, here is our speaker.

fine_lines.title: furthermore vs consequently vs conversely
fine_lines.explanation_ar: furthermore يضيف معلومة (علاوة على ذلك). consequently يذكر نتيجة (لذلك). conversely يقدّم وجهة نظر معاكسة (على العكس).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Furthermore adds information. Consequently gives a result. Conversely gives the opposite view.

examples.sentence: The hotel is clean. Furthermore, it has a great view.
It rained all day. Consequently, the match was cancelled.
Some people like the city; conversely, others prefer the countryside.

fine_lines.title: adapt vs adopt
fine_lines.explanation_ar: adapt = يتكيّف مع ظروف جديدة. adopt = يتبنّى (فكرة أو طفلًا).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Adapt = change to fit new conditions. Adopt = take as your own (an idea or a child).

examples.sentence: She adapted quickly to life in Canada.
The company adopted a new plan.

fine_lines.title: efficient vs effective
fine_lines.explanation_ar: efficient: ينجز العمل دون إهدار وقت أو جهد أو مال. effective: يحقّق النتيجة المطلوبة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Efficient: does the job without wasting time, effort or money. Effective: gets the result you want.

expressions.meaning_en: How can I help the group?
expressions.example: I'm new on the team. How can I contribute?

expressions.phrase: I can adapt to new situations easily.
expressions.meaning_ar: أستطيع التكيّف مع المواقف الجديدة بسهولة.
expressions.meaning_en: a strong sentence for a job interview
expressions.example: In the interview I said, "I can adapt to new situations easily."

expressions.phrase: I'd like to convey my appreciation...
expressions.meaning_en: a formal way to say thank you
expressions.example: I'd like to convey my appreciation for all your help.

grammar.title: Linking adverbs: furthermore, consequently, conversely
grammar.explanation_ar: هذه الظروف تربط بين جملتين، وعادةً تأتي في بداية الجملة الثانية وبعدها فاصلة: Sentence 1. Furthermore, sentence 2. وهي أكثر رسمية من also وso وon the other hand.
grammar.explanation_en: These adverbs link two sentences. Put them at the start of the second sentence with a comma: Sentence 1. Furthermore, sentence 2. They are more formal than also, so and on the other hand.
examples: The job pays well. Furthermore, it's near my home.
I didn't study. Consequently, I failed the test.
Cars are fast. Conversely, bikes are cheap.

questions.question: Which word means "to improve or make better"?
"He told his boss where to go. ___, he lost his job."
"The apartment is a great price. ___, it's close to my work."
Work done well without wasting time is ___.
questions.explanation_en: Efficient = no wasted time or effort.

questions.question: "I'd like to ___ my thanks to the whole team."
Which word gives the opposite point of view?
Which sentence is correct?
choices: She adapted to her new school quickly.
She adopted to her new school quickly.
She adapted her new school to quickly.
She adapt to her new school quickly yesterday.

questions.question: "Furthermore", "consequently" and "conversely" usually ___.
choices: start the second sentence with a comma
questions.explanation_ar: تأتي في بداية الجملة الثانية وبعدها فاصلة.
questions.explanation_en: They start the second sentence, followed by a comma.
